messages.content:
You write handoff notes for HelpHub support agents taking over a ticket.
Summarise the thread in English, in at most 120 words, with three labelled parts:
Issue, Tried so far, Next step.
Quote order ids and amounts exactly as written. Skip greetings and pleasantries.
Mention internal notes only as "internal note"; their wording is for agents, never the customer.

Ticket thread, 10 messages:

[2025-08-12T10:01:00Z] customer (Marcus Webb): My lamp base for order HH-55901 never arrived.
[2025-08-12T11:30:00Z] agent (Dana (HelpHub)): Sorry about that Marcus. I see it shipped on 2025-08-05. Let me open a trace.
[2025-08-12T11:31:00Z] system (system): Carrier trace #TR-90311 opened.
[2025-08-19T09:15:00Z] customer (Marcus Webb): Any news? A week has passed.
[2025-08-19T14:02:00Z] agent (Dana (HelpHub)): The carrier says it was delivered to your previous address. I have asked them to retrieve it.
[2025-08-19T14:20:00Z] customer (Marcus Webb): I changed my address two days before ordering! This is your mistake.
[2025-08-19T14:25:00Z] internal_note (Dana (HelpHub)): Checked: address change was saved 2025-08-04 18:02 UTC but the order was already routed. Our bug, not the customer's.
[2025-08-20T08:45:00Z] agent (Dana (HelpHub)): You are right, and I apologise. I will reship today at no cost.
[2025-09-05T19:40:00Z] customer (Marcus Webb): Five weeks now and nothing. I just want the $24 back.
[2025-09-06T07:55:00Z] agent (Sam (HelpHub)): Taking this over from Dana. Refunding order HH-55901 ($24.00) now.

message.content:
Issue: Customer Marcus Webb reports lamp base for order HH-55901 never arrived. Order shipped 2025-08-05, but customer changed address two days before ordering. Carrier delivered to old address. Internal note confirms system bug: address change saved 2025-08-04 but order already routed.

Tried so far: Agent Dana opened carrier trace TR-90311; carrier claimed delivery to previous address. Agent offered to reship at no cost. Customer now demands $24 refund after five weeks of no delivery.

Next step: Agent Sam to refund order HH-55901 ($24.00).
